title: Short-ASCII family FC4 captures (Anern and Maxinn sites)
summary: Read-only FC4 MP/Q1/MD plus optional F/RH/RB exchanges from Anern- and Maxinn-site support evidence share one fixed-length Short-ASCII dialect. Evidence qualifies the family runtime path only; it is not proof of any retail model name. One live member correlates RH=1 BMS current decimals with SmartValue; Maxinn currents remain unproven separately. Live PV and controls are absent from these captures.
